title: Lanternway - The Walking Tune
_note: The signature cosy travel loop, the soundtrack's beating heart. gbc 4-voice band. 120 BPM, 4/4, comfortable G major. 32-bar AABA. Vesper motif in BOUNCING form: rising leap rendered springy/skipping (D4->G4->A4 lift), settle-home turned into a cheerful hop (B4->A4->G4). lead=plucky pulse25, most singable hook, range G4-D5. harmony=light bell arps on offbeats (Light signature), skipping. bass=springy walking eighths, the engine. drums=brisk kick/snare/hat with a fill before the loop seam. Transposed to G: motif on D4(5)->G4->A4 ... B4->A4->G4. Last bar D7(dom) -> resolves to G downbeat.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: AABA. A (bars 1-8): bouncing Vesper hook in G. B (bars 17-24): lift to em/C with a skip. A (bars 25-32): home. Springy dotted/eighth phrasing.
